newsitem.title: USA: Consumers shrs repriced at $3.78 in merger.
newsitem.headline: Consumers shrs repriced at $3.78 in merger.

text.p: Consumers Financial Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to extend the time for closing its merger with LaSalle Group Inc to April 30, subject to certain conditions.
The company also said it had agreed on a pricing formula designed to eliminate any further erosion of the merger consideration to be received by its common shareholders.
Under the adjustment, the company said that LaSalle will pay $3.78 for each share of Consumers Financial, instead of $3.92 per share.

Because regulatory approvals must still be obtained and because the company estimates that its capital and surplus will continue to decline, it believes this amendment to the merger agreement is in the shareholders best interests.
Consumers Financial is an insurance holding company which provides management training and education services as well as credit insurance and other products to automobile dealers.
